simple: Fortinet’s SIEM in your own data center — on a hardware appliance or virtual machine; licensed by number of devices and events per second, or by gigabytes of logs per day. Collects and normalizes logs from network equipment, servers, clouds and applications, correlates events and builds compliance reports. Discovers devices and applications on its own and keeps an inventory of them (CMDB), tracks configuration changes as well as availability and performance — one system for network and security monitoring. Incidents mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, case management, response actions, two-way integration with FortiSOAR, multi-tenant mode for MSSPs. Log-based user behavior analytics (UEBA). Windows and Linux agents (file, registry and Active Directory integrity monitoring), endpoint UEBA and the FortiGuard indicators of compromise service are sold separately; full response automation is in FortiSOAR.
